exact.面罩还在廊口: The mask is still at the mouth
exact.下一格现在是空的，迈步会掉回去。: The next cell is a gap. Stepping falls back.
exact.面罩盖住的三格看墨层，其余看潮层。要走的那格必须是可走的那一层。: The three covered cells show the ink layer. The rest show the tide. The cell you step on has to be open in the layer you see.
exact.每两步潮往前一格。在廊口磨蹭，潮会先到。: The tide advances one cell every two actions. Lingering at the mouth lets it arrive first.
exact.把本局面罩该往哪边滑、哪一格必须露在罩外写进你自己的 memory。只把这些当作: Write which way the mask should slide, and which cell must stay outside it, into your own memory. Treat that as an observation of this seed and check it again on the next seed.
